title: Stick to What You Know: A Study of Knowledge-Aligned Supervised Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2608.30987v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) trains a base language model to imitate target responses, and these targets may require knowledge the base model has not robustly internalized. We study this as a source of hallucinations and frame a group of mitigation methods as \emph{knowledge-aligned SFT}: constraining SFT training targets to the base model's parametric knowledge. Under a unified setup, we compare existing generation-based and estimation-based knowledge-alignment methods and introduce two new variants: Evidence Rewrite, which verifies base-model generations using external evidence, and Recall Rewrite, which retains claims only when they can be consistently recalled by the base model. Experiments with Qwen 3 4B and OLMo 3 7B show that knowledge-aligned SFT can reduce factual hallucinations on WildHalu and Biography while largely preserving general capabilities. translated_title: 坚守所知：知识对齐监督微调研究
translated_abstract: 监督微调（SFT）训练基础语言模型去模仿目标回复，而这些目标可能需要基础模型尚未稳健内化的知识。我们将这一现象作为幻觉的一个来源进行研究，并将一组缓解方法框架化为“知识对齐SFT”：将SFT训练目标限制在基础模型的参数化知识范围内。在统一实验设置下，我们比较了现有的基于生成和基于估计的知识对齐方法，并引入了两个新变体：证据重写（Evidence Rewrite），利用外部证据验证基础模型的生成内容；以及召回重写（Recall Rewrite），仅保留基础模型能够一致召回的声明。在Qwen 3 4B和OLMo 3 7B上的实验表明，知识对齐SFT可以在大幅保持通用能力的同时，减少WildHalu和Biography数据集上的事实性幻觉。召回重写带来了最强的事实性提升，并改善了拒答行为。
tldr: 该论文提出“知识对齐SFT”框架，通过将微调训练目标限制在基础模型已内化的参数化知识范围内——尤其是新提出的召回重写方法——在保持通用能力的同时显著减少了语言模型的事实性幻觉。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "knowledge-aligned SFT," which constrains fine-tuning targets to the base model's parametric knowledge—most effectively via the newly introduced Recall Rewrite method—reducing factual hallucinations while largely preserving general capabilities.
